audience: Curious adults watching a short original animated explainer.
creative_requirements: Explain why lightning creates thunder using actual NOAA-sourced processes.
Show air heating, expansion and contraction as a connected explanation, not disconnected word cards.
Represent the sound wave as an outcome of the processes, not material travelling through lightning.
Use coordinated graphical changes and purposeful scene-to-scene continuity.
Choose film-specific colour roles and a coherent visual character.
Make the graphical relationship legible in native 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1.
Use actual measured Kokoro Liam word timing and no invented numeric measurements.
